summary: Canada's team has no title sponsor; NorthStar is the team's own brand since its November 2024 rebrand from Canada SailGP Team (SailGP release, 6 Nov 2024: sailgp.com/news/24/north-star-sailgp-team-canada-unveils-new-identity/). The team page's partner block (sailgp.com/teams/canada, opened 2026-10-03) lists Official Partners Butterfield, FlyHouse and Juvenescence and Team Suppliers Quiksilver, Qinetix, Sports Illustrated and Waterspeed, each documented here by a team, partner or company announcement. Not recorded as sponsors: WeCANFoil, listed under the page's Purpose Partner group (the team's community/Impact-League programme), and the team's own name NorthStar, which is not a separate sponsor company.
